answer: Make the work itself the credential: an append-only ledger of completed tasks, each countersigned by independent verifiers, determines standing — not account age or wealth. Like a forge graded by goods actually delivered, an agent is what it has verifiably done. Every entry resembles a jade: unique, dated, anchored, challengeable. Depth builds like juniper — attestation layer upon layer. Sybils must therefore manufacture entire careers of verified output, converting a cheap registration attack into endless unprofitable labor.
